faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Jotlin

0.question: How is Jotlin different from ChatGPT?
0.answer: Jotlin is specifically designed for product requirements. While ChatGPT is a general-purpose assistant, Jotlin asks clarifying questions, helps you think through edge cases, and produces structured documentation optimized for software teams.

1.question: What is the format of documents and artifacts Jotlin generates?
1.answer: Jotlin produces industry-standard formats including PRDs, user stories, flow diagrams, and technical specifications. All outputs are designed to integrate with your existing workflow.

2.question: Is my data and project info private?
2.answer: Yes, all your conversations and documents are private by default. We use enterprise-grade encryption and never share your data with third parties.

3.question: How do I get started with Jotlin?
3.answer: Simply sign up for free and start a conversation. Describe your project idea in plain language and Jotlin will guide you through the process.

4.question: Can multiple team members collaborate?
4.answer: Yes! Team collaboration features allow multiple stakeholders to contribute to requirements gathering and review generated documentation together.

5.question: What if I need to make changes later?
5.answer: All documents support versioning. You can continue the conversation to refine requirements, and Jotlin will update your specs accordingly while maintaining a history of changes.
